p, K = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def fast_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if K == 0:
    print(fast_pow(p, p - 1))
elif K == 1:
    print(fast_pow(p, p))
else:
    visited = [False] * p
    count_cycles = 0
    for i in range(p):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        size = 0
        tmp = i
        while not visited[tmp]:
            size += 1
            visited[tmp] = True
            tmp = (tmp * K) % p
        if size > 1:
            count_cycles += 1
    print(fast_pow(p, count_cycles))
